observations.name: Additional observations
observations.description: ARPAV stations do not observe the state of the sky, and some of them report neither visibility nor pressure. The aerodromes below, listed nearest first, publish a METAR observation every 30 minutes and can complete the missing data. Keep in mind that a distant aerodrome describes the general sky well and local fog or low clouds badly.

data.metar_fill_missing: Use it for the data the station does not provide
